newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR maintains inverted yield curve.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR maintains inverted yield curve.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were unchanged for the third consecutive session, keeping an inverted yield curve as near-term interest rate outlook remained unclear, traders said.

"Banks are keeping a defensive stand, because short-term rates are the most vulnerable in case of another attack on the peso," one trader said. The peso remained fragile as speculative attacks on regional currencies persist.
PHIBOR are average of swap rates quoted by 20 banks operating in the country.
